mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM drinks d JOIN drinks t ON t.drink_id = #{drinkId} WHERE d.shop_id = t.shop_id AND d.drink_id != #{drinkId} AND LOWER(TRIM(d.drink_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(#{drinkName})) AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.is_deleted = FALSE AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.is_deleted = FALSE )
SELECT shop_id FROM drinks WHERE drink_id = #{drinkId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_deleted = FALSE
